gates.text: Supervise and review; delegate attempts.
One hypothesis, one change, one measurement, then keep or revert.
Never stack untested changes.
Ground architecture through [how](workflows.md#how).
Name realistic workload dimensions such as size, history, state, and concurrency, and reproduce the complaint.
If nothing reproduces it, repair the repro first.
Fix the metric, better direction, target, and minimum attempt count before changes.
Use the user's numbers or obtain agreement on missing material targets.
A lucky early win does not satisfy the target-plus-minimum-attempt predicate.
Prove harness sensitivity with contrasting realistic workloads that separate as expected.
Revise a harness that cannot distinguish them.
Vet it with [benchmark-checklist](workflows.md#benchmark-checklist), then freeze one repeatable command that prints the sampled metric, error count, and completed-work count.
Record the baseline and a green regression gate before the first change.
Open the append-only [show-me-your-work](workflows.md#show-me-your-work) trail.
Keep the attempt log out of the tracked tree.
Read it before each attempt.
Record id, architecture-grounded hypothesis, change, before, after, delta, tests, kept or reverted, and note.
For performance hypotheses use [perf-issue](#perf-issue)'s mantra order, not its early-target stop rule.
Resolve each `hillclimb` attempt through `pstack_route` and delegate with emitted native `sessions_spawn` arguments and tight scope.
Independent attempts use separate worktrees; the lead reviews rather than types their changes.
If required delegation cannot run, the attempt gate is BLOCKED, never a sequential parent fallback.
Measure before and after with the frozen harness and run the regression gate.
Keep only gains beyond noise with green correctness, or a simplification that holds the metric.
Otherwise revert the whole attempt.
With commit authority, make one scoped commit per kept attempt and log kept and reverted outcomes before starting the next.
Without it, mark the commit checkpoint BLOCKED rather than claiming it happened.
Push past the first plateau.
Pivot category, revisit source, or combine measured near-misses before declaring ideas exhausted.
Correctness and simplicity outrank the metric.
Stop at the target plus minimum attempts, a genuine blocker, or documented exhaustion where remaining ideas are marginal relative to cost.
Do not relax the predicate or stop with cheap untried hypotheses.
A budget expiry is an incomplete handoff, not success.
**Reply.** Metric and target, baseline and final with percent delta, attempts kept and reverted, each accepted fix, log path, next best hypothesis, and unmet gates.
No persistent loop is created; an authorized unattended run may borrow only [autonomous-run](#autonomous-run)'s wake mechanism.

7. Never set a missing attempt minimum yourself. If the user gave only a maximum, such as at most 2 attempts, run attempts up to that maximum and stop earlier only on a genuine blocker or documented exhaustion; a kept win before then does not end the run. If the user gave neither, ask for the number or agree it before the first attempt.
